dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions are multiple high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. These feature light-intensity line perimeters with sharp, non-linear edge geometries. The transition from the darker charcoal exterior fur to the lighter-intensity ring boundaries is abrupt, with some larger rings in the posterior-lateral section exhibiting interior regions slightly lighter than the base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, point-like high-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior-ventral (neck) region. These clusters lack internal gradients and form a localized, asymmetrical speckled pattern that dissipates into lower densities toward the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent annuli on the upper-posterior surface form an obtuse scalene triangle. A distinct longitudinal vector is formed by the spatial relationship between the center of the anterior neck speckle cluster and the leading edge of the most prominent mid-dorsal ring.
